metadata.method: Vertex AI count_tokens API — actual token counts, not estimates
metadata.b5_note: 60% reduction is the ARCHITECTURAL TARGET. Actual savings require authoring the static reference layer and deploying Context Caching. These numbers prove the economics.
metadata.portability: Any AI pipeline with a stable reference corpus benefits from this pattern. Static/dynamic split is domain-agnostic: legal (case law), finance (regulatory reference), insurance (policy definitions).

static_layer.description: System prompt + medical reference protocols (same for every call)
static_layer.caching_strategy: Vertex Context Caching — cached once per TTL window, read at 75% discount

dynamic_layer.description: Per-call content: BM25-retrieved encounter docs + user query
